notes: Back panel of an MDH Kitchen King mixed spices powder carton, 100 g, lying flat on a dark granite tabletop with a Rs 10 coin flat in the same plane to its right, shot straight down at 1214 x 1295 px. The file is a PNG despite the .jpg name it arrived under, so it is filed as .png; the bytes are untouched and the sha256 is theirs. The first calibrated field capture in this corpus. Calibration: the coin is the largest elliptical contour, at normalised bbox above, 252.6 x 258.3 px, 0.1045 mm/px through app.modules.measurement.detect_reference_object; the detector reads the flat coin as 12 degrees tilted from rim shadow, which is a known artefact (session log, Session 36). pdp dimensions are the carton face marked at (68, 22, 808, 1244) px through measure_panel_dimensions with that calibration: 128.6 x 77.4 mm, 99.6 cm2, the 50-100 cm2 band. The mark hugs the red carton edge; a mark tighter to the printed face measures 92-96 cm2 in the same band. net_quantity.numeral_height_mm is the pipeline's calibrated measurement of the '100' digits on this session's run, 2.508 mm (+/- 0.13); the 'g' with its descender is not a numeral. The pipeline's verdict on this capture is REVIEW because of evidence items (contrast ratio handed to the officer, a second reader disagreeing on one span), none of which is a defect of the package; every obligation is present and legible, so the package's own verdict is PASS. Batch KK2407 printed; Rule 26 does not reach a 100 g pack.
